summary: Added the ne() validator to attrs.validators. In src/attr/validators.py I inserted "ne" into __all__ alphabetically between "min_len" and "not_", and added def ne(val) right after gt returning _NumberValidator(val, "!=", operator.ne) with the requested docstring and versionadded 26.2.0. In src/attr/validators.pyi I added def ne(val: _T) -> _ValidatorType[_T] after the gt line. In docs/api.rst I added the attrs.validators.ne autofunction block with the doctest showing C(43) succeeds and C(42) raises ValueError: ("'x' must be != 42: 42"). Created changelog.d/1571.change.md with the one-line changelog entry. Acceptance check .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_validators.py passed with 168 tests.
